querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      broker_id,
                                      typecode,
                                      start_date,
                                      closing_date,
                                      make_market_num,
                                      listed_companies_num,
                                      market_making_enterprise_ratio,
                                      trading_volume,
                                      trading_volume_ratio,
                                      market_turnover,
                                      market_turnover_ratio,
                                      report_period,
                                      supervision_company_num,
                                      this_period_disclosure_num,
                                      accumulative_disclosure_num,
                                      not_yet_disclosure_num,
                                      corrections_num,
                                      delayed_disclosure_num,
                                      existing_problems_num,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_neeqweekreportsofbrokers.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.neeqweekreportsofbrokers
